descriptions: jiào "ào-ào"-de, bù zài jiā-lǐ huó-de dòng-wù
notes: the dictionary's form of 狼 is 10 words (jiào "ào-ào"-de, bù zài jiā-lǐ huó-de dòng-wù), and in a sentence of its own its jiào reads as "is called Ao-ao"; the English gives "a big bad animal" itself, so that is used, and a reader may not see that it is a wolf
the form of 狼 is 10 words; kept its jiào "ào-ào"-de and used the story's dà huài dòng-wù for the rest
the dictionary's form of 狼 is 10 words (jiào "ào-ào"-de, bù zài jiā-lǐ huó-de dòng-wù); the story's own note asks for "the big bad animal", which says any big bad animal, not a wolf
lǎo-shì splits into lǎo + shì after a subject and the sentence stops parsing; shénme shí-jiān dōu made the sentence 15 words with over 500 readings; hái (still) keeps that he wanted more
the form of 愤怒 is 7 words (xīn-lǐ yǒu hěn dà-de huǒ); shortened as the story's note does, fire in the heart, with le for got angry
no short word: the dictionary's form is 11 words (hěn duō zài yī-qǐ gōng-zuò-de xiǎo dòng-wù), so the text's own note (a little black animal) is used, named zhè-ge xiǎo dòng-wù after
kb_lookup: nothing says asleep; said as sleeping there
nothing says at all; shenme-dou carries not anything
no word for axe; the English itself says a tool, and kb_hints starts it from gōng-jù; nothing for cutting (切 qiē has no short form) sets it apart
no word for bean (kb_lookup gives only chī-de zhíwù, vegetable, and shuǐ-guǒ, fruit, as kinds); the test set's literal, little round things

no word for bear; the dictionary's form (from 熊) is hěn zhòng-de dà dòng-wù, 6 words, and a bear comes in almost every sentence, so the test set's own wording (big animals) is used; the kind of animal is lost, and the big bear is said the same way as the bears
the form of 无聊 is 8 words (méi yǒu hǎo wánr-de, méi-shì zuò); said as the story's note does, he felt nothing was fun
fall is the form of 掉 (dào dì-shàng); nothing short for the crash
the dictionary's form ràng-rén-zuò-xià-de dōng-xi is 7 words, so it gets a sentence of its own (the cast list) and is zhè-ge dōng-xi after; the bear's "my chair" becomes "this thing"
no entry; the hole at the top, the English text's own words
the form of 爬 is yòng shǒu hé jiǎo shàng-qù (with hands and feet), odd for a wolf; shàng-qù (went up) is weaker

The form of 鸭子 is 9 words (zài shuǐ-lǐ zǒu-de fēi-de dòng-wù); for one mention the mother is a bird mother by the water, as the text's own literal note names the ducklings. The duck itself is weaker: a bird near water.
No entry (kb_lookup's only row is a kind-of guess: meat). The text's own literal: six little flying animals.
the dictionary's form is zài-shuǐ-lǐ-de dòng-wù; zài dropped so the noun reads inside other sentences
no word; the form of 傻 and 笨, as the text's literal note says

idea: fool (as a name you call someone)
notes: "your head is not good" says stupid, not the insult; marked colour
the fire in her heart is very big; shēng-qì glosses as "give birth-air", so not used
no word for giant (kb_lookup gives only dòng-wù as a kind); the test set's literal, a really big person
the book's yellow (the story's literal note); "golden" as gold-made is not said

descriptions: yī-ge dà dòng-wù, then Tā shì zhíwù-de yánsè.
notes: no entry: kb_lookup gives only the kind (dòng-wù) and, wrongly, alcohol as a second kind; the text's own note (a big green animal) is used, the colour in a sentence of its own, named zhè-ge dà dòng-wù after
no word; the dictionary's form of 兔子 is 7 words, so it gets a sentence of its own and then a quoted name ("Kuài-kuai")

"tǎng zài lǎo nǚ-rén-de shuìjiào-de dì-fang", "... lǎo nǚ-rén shuìjiào-de dì-fang", "... tā-de shuìjiào-de dì-fang" and "zài lǎo nǚ-rén shuìjiào-de dì-fang tǎng" can't mean "he lay down in her bed" in any of the first 500 readings; the owner is left to the house the wolf is in
keep on has only liú (keep a thing); still + now-ing says it
a good person; kindness itself is not named
no entry: kb_lookup "lie" gives only tǎng (lie down); said as the story's note does, not saying true things

the dictionary's form of 逐渐 (gradually), yī-diǎn yī-diǎn, reads before a verb only as two clock times (yī diǎn, one o'clock) or as a subject, never as bit by bit; said as walking very slowly, so it may come back weaker (colour)
住 has only the frame X-de jiā zài …; huó (live) with zài and a place, as in the book's fisherman sentence

descriptions: Shéi dōu méi kàn-guò zhè-zhǒng dōng-xi.
notes: no word for magic; said as the test set's literal (never seen before), a sentence of its own
no word; sleep for a moment
cóng-lái (the form of 从来) reads only as cóng + lái, and zài yě reads zài as at; not ever is said as not any more (bù … le)
"does not come back any more"; cóng-lái (ever) splits into cóng + lái in the parse, so never is weaker
xīn says new, but its gloss and hanzi read heart (心); the text's literal note gives seen for the first time
no entry; said by grammar, méi-yǒu rén and the verb
listen to my words; Mandarin's own phrasing
no entry for the story opener; yǒu yī tiān (there was one day), built from tian-nian-spans
No entry; kb_lookup's same-sense row (hěn duō dōng-xi zài yī-qǐ, a pile) is a false friend. The text's own literal: hit him.

descriptions: jiā-lǐ yǒu-de, chī hěn duō-de dà dòng-wù
notes: the dictionary's form of 猪 is 11 words and does not say little; the English note's "animals that say oink-oink" became jiào "hēng-hēng"-de xiǎo dòng-wù, in the shape of the dog and cat forms

descriptions: bǎ méi-yǒu-de yīfu fàng zài shēntǐ-shàng
notes: no word for pretend (kb_lookup gives only xiǎng shì, guess); the clothes that are not there carry the quotes
the story's own literal note; the king form is 10 words and no woman ruler form exists, so the queen is only "the biggest person"
no word for a race; the dictionary's form of 比赛 (competition) is kàn shéi zuì hǎo, so see who is fastest
kuài zǒu dào X-de jiā (ran to X's house) never has that reading in 500, so ran became went quickly

idea: say that someone is a fool
notes: shuō takes no whole sentence (feel-state's shuō + state needs a bare describing word; know-that is zhīdào only), so people will think, not say
the story's literal note; the dictionary's form (hěn-dà-de yǒu-shuǐ-de dì-fang) is 8 words
the dictionary's form of 羊 is 11 words (máo hěn duō, chī dì shàng-de zhíwù-de dòng-wù); the story's note gives "white-haired animals", 6 words, short enough to repeat
the form of 棍 is cháng-de dōng-xi, vague (any long thing); de dropped to keep the nesting low
the form of 石头 is hěn yìng hěn zhòng-de dōng-xi (7 words); used the English note's hard things
no entry (kb_lookup gives only liào, material); the book's own phrase, close to the English note's little yellow plants
the dictionary's form is 7 words (nián-lǐ zuì rè-de shí-jiān); the text's own note (the hot time) is 4 and pairs with winter's lěng-de shí-jiān
swim is zài shuǐ-lǐ wánr (play in the water); "went into the water" keeps the movement only

No entry; kb_lookup offers only a wrong same-sense row (yī-dìng, definitely). Described as the text itself describes swans (big white birds); about 7 words, so said once and pointed back to with nà sān-ge fēi-de dòng-wù.

descriptions: duì rén shuō bù shì zhēn-de huà-de rén
notes: the dictionary's form is 10 words, so its verb part has a sentence of its own (Tā-men duì rén shuō bù shì zhēn-de huà.) and tā-men names them after
the dictionary's form of 尝 is a clause of its own (chī yī-diǎn, kàn wèi-dào, 6 words); ate a little is used, so trying the flavour is weaker

idea: the whole sea to be mine
descriptions: Hěn dà-de shuǐ wǒ dōu yào!
notes: "I want all of the big water"; "to be mine" (owning) is weaker, the book's dōu shì wǒ-de had no meant reading
然后 is X-wán hòu, too heavy here; the order of the sentences says it

descriptions: Tā bù yào zhè-xiē dōng-xi le. … ná-chū-qù
notes: the dictionary's form of 扔 (bù yào X le, ná-chū-qù) says not wanting and taking out, not the throwing movement; split over two sentences to keep the window

descriptions: shēntǐ-de wài-miàn hěn yìng; zǒu-de hěn bù kuài
notes: no word; the dictionary's form of 乌龟 is 16 words (shēntǐ wài-miàn yǒu yìng-de dōng-xi, zǒu-de hěn bù kuài-de dòng-wù), so the animal is described in two sentences and then named ("Yìng-ying")
no word; the head of the dictionary's 盆 (tub) form, which is 11 words. Glossary proposal below

descriptions: ràng tiān shàng xià-lái-de shuǐ bù dào shēntǐ shàng-de dōng-xi
notes: the dictionary's own form is 14 words, so it gets a sentence of its own (the cast list)
